קבוצת אסם היא דוגמה מצוינת כיצד לבחון את חוקי הכשרות על פי הלכה (החוק הדתי היהודי). במשך 13 השנים האחרונות, התקנת הכשרות במתקנים של יצרן המזון המוביל בישראל נמצאת תחת הדרכתו של רבי יעקב משה הארלפ, רב התאגיד. חוקי הכשרות מיושמים בקפידה לאורך תהליך הייצור של אלפי פריטים שונים, המיוצרים במפעלי ייצור ברחבי ישראל ובעולם. התקנת הפיקוח הכשרות מבטיחה שהמערכת מתפקדת כראוי בכל האזורים הקשורים לשרות לאורך כל תהליך הייצור. הסט הזה הפועל באופן מקצועי וקפדני מבטיח שכל יהודי שומר על הכשרים יכול ליהנות ממוצרי Osem-Nestle בכל מקום בעולם ללא צורך בדאגה.

تعد مجموعة أوسم مثالاً جيدًا على كيفية مراقبة قوانين كشروت وفقًا لحلاشة (القانون الديني اليهودي). على مدار الـ 13 سنة الأخيرة، كانت نشرت في منشآت صانع الطعام الرائد هذا في إسرائيل تحت إشراف رابي ياكوف موشي هارب، رابي. تُطبق قوانين كشروت بدقة خلال عملية إنتاج الآلاف من المنتجات المختلفة، المصنوعة في نباتات الإنتاج في جميع أنحاء إسرائيل والعالم. يضمن إعداد الإشراف على كاشروت أن يعمل النظام بشكل صحيح في جميع المناطق المتعلقة بكاشروت خلال عملية الإنتاج. يضمن هذا الإعداد الذي يعمل بطريقة احترافية ودماغية أن كل شخص يحب الكششوت يمكنه الاستمتاع بمنتجات أوسم-نستل في أي مكان في العالم دون أي قلق.

O Grupo Osem é um bom exemplo de como observar as leis de kashrut de acordo com Halacha (lei religiosa judaica). Nos últimos 13 anos, a configuração de kashrut nas instalações deste fabricante líder de alimentos em Israel foi sob a orientação do Rabbi Yaakov Moshe Harlap, o Rabino da corporação. As leis da kashrut são meticulosamente aplicadas ao longo do procedimento de produção de milhares de itens diferentes, fabricados em plantas de produção em todo Israel e o mundo. A configuração de supervisão de kashrut garante que o sistema funcione adequadamente em todas as áreas pertencentes ao kashrut durante o processo de produção. Esta configuração que funciona de forma profissional e meticulosa garante que todos os judeus observadores de kashrut possam desfrutar de produtos Osem-Nestle em qualquer lugar do mundo sem qualquer necessidade de preocupação.

Osem Group 是如何按照 Halacha (猶太宗教法)遵守 kashrut 法律的好例。 過去 13 年來,在以色列這家領先食品製造商的工廠中建立了 kashrut 一直在該公司 Rabbi Yaakov Moshe Harlap 的指導下。 kashrut 的定律在以色列和世界各地的生產工廠製造數千種不同物品的生產過程中精心製作。 kashrut 的監督設置確保該系統在整個生產過程中與 kashrut 相關的所有區域都能正常運作。 這種設置以專業和嚴謹的方式運作,確保每個符合 kashrut 標準的猶太人都可以在世界上任何地方享受 Osem-Nestle 的產品,無需擔憂。

Osem Group 是如何根据哈拉查(犹太宗教法)观察喀什鲁特法律的一个很好的例子。 在过去的13年里,Kashrut 在以色列这家主要食品制造商的Rabbi Yaakov Moshe Harlap的指导下成立。 在以色列和世界各地的生产工厂中生产成千上万种不同的物品,克什鲁特法律在整个生产程序中被精心应用。 Kashrut 监管设置确保该系统在生产过程中在与 kashrut 相关的所有领域正常工作。 这套设备以专业和谨慎的方式运行,确保每个喀什鲁特观察者都可以享受世界上任何地方的 Osem-Nestle 产品。

Osem Group은 Halacha(유대인 종교법)에 따라 카슈루트의 법칙을 준수하는 방법에 대한 훌륭한 예입니다. 지난 13년 동안, 이스라엘 최고의 식품 제조업체의 시설에 카슈루트는 회사의 랍비인 랍비 야코프 모셰 하랩의 지도를 받아 왔습니다. 카슈루트의 법칙은 이스라엘과 전 세계 생산 공장에서 제조된 수천 가지의 다른 품목의 생산 과정에서 꼼꼼하게 적용됩니다. 카슈루트 감독 설정은 생산 과정에서 카슈루트와 관련된 모든 영역에서 시스템이 올바르게 작동하도록 합니다. 전문적이고 꼼꼼한 방식으로 작동하는 이 설정은 모든 카슈루트를 관찰하는 유령이 우려 없이 전 세계 어디에서나 Osem-Nestle 제품을 즐길 수 있도록 합니다.

title: Kit Kat chocolate special Japanese Dagashi Box 20 pieces w/ AKIBA KING Sticker
bullet_point: [You can try to eat Japanese Kit Kat mini chocolate!! Please put it in the refrigerator immediately after the product arrives., Dagashi refers to cheap candies and snack foods. Dagashi are comparable to American penny candy. The word "dagashi" is derived from the Japanese words "da" ("futile" or "negligible") and "kashi" (snacks)., The low price and fun packaging is designed to attract children with small allowances, and "dagashi" came to be known as the small candies that children can afford with pocket money., Most dagashi are packaged in bright, childish wrapping and sometimes come with a small toy or prize. The toys are often small figurines, and a common prize is a randomized prize that will allow the holder to claim a second free snack. Dagashi used to be sold in stores specializing primarily in dagashi called "dagashiya" ., Box size: 165×120×30(mm) with AKIBA KING Sticker!]
description: This picture is as image but you can get 20 kit kat chocolate! While the modern dagashi was developed after World War 2, dagashi has been around since the Edo period (1603-1868), though the region of origin is unknown. "Dagashi", made from starch or corn, was the commoner equivalent of the more expensive "jōgashi", which was higher quality and made from white sugar. Modern dagashi experienced its greatest popularity from the 1950s to the early 1980s in Japan when dagashiyas were common and a staple after-school hangout spot for younger students. However, in the early to mid- 1980s, dagashiya stores began to diversify their products or were replaced by convenience stores. As of 2016, dagashi can still be found in the occasional dagashiya or ordered online. Culture expos in Japan (especially for schools) sometimes include dagashi and dagashiya displays.

Fairytale Brownies believes in giving back to the community and donates thousands of pounds of brownies to the Society of St. Vincent De Paul in the Phoenix area. Nationally, Fairytale Brownies supports KaBOOM!, the non-profit organization that envisions a great place to play within walking distance of every child in America. How did our Oatmeal Chocolate Chip bite-letter originate? Dr. Laura tells the story of how this healthy oatmeal chocolate chip cookie was created: “As a kid, I did not eat the regular chocolate chip cookies that people are familiar with. My grandma raised six kids on a farm, so she made a healthy oatmeal chocolate chip cookie that was part energy and part snack. It was very filling, and everything we ate always had the whole grain. When I was thinking about what flavor of healthy cookie to make when I first started my company, I naturally thought of my grandma’s healthy oatmeal chocolate chip cookie. I’m a soft cookie person, so I wanted something soft and chewy. description: For centuries on Christmas Eve, families in Poland, Lithuania, the Czech and Slav Republics have practiced a beautiful tradition. It is the breaking and sharing of the Oplatek - Christmas Wafer. Oplatek taken from the Latin word oblatum, meaning Sacred Bread, has been the symbol of Christianity and Jesus Christ our bread of life since the Last Supper. On the Holiest Night of the year a festive 12 course meatless dinner is prepared for the gathered family and friends. An extra setting is placed for a beggar (our Lord) who may come to the door, or a poor family (the Holy Family) looking for a place to stay. The host or hostess leads in a special prayer and distributes an oplatek to the participants. Each person breaks off a piece of the other’s oplatek and continues until they have exchanged good wishes and blessings with everyone. Traditionally at midnight the head of the household takes the pink oplatek and shares it with the animals on his farm or at his home. This custom brings us back to that Holy Night when even animals were able to speak, and to remind us that we are all God’s creatures.

Royal Icing (dry hard icing): Into ½ cup cold water, beat ¼ cup meringue powder until stiff peaks form. Scrape the sides of the bowl and completely mix the water and meringue. description: Gluten-Free Prairie (GFP) is a Montana, woman owned and family operated business built on the foundation of the American dream that anything is possible. In 2005 GFP co-founder Deb and her daughter, Amy were diagnosed with Celiac Disease; an autoimmune disease requiring a lifetime commitment to a gluten-free diet. In 2012 the family followed their passion to bring healthy gluten-free products to the millions of consumers who are avoiding gluten.Gluten-Free Prairie (or GFP as it’s called by the family) strives to create gluten-free food that is not only safe for celiacs and gluten-intolerant people, but also people with no wheat allergies at all. Jeremy Wheaton, the baker in the group, has developed the recipes with flavor in mind. We think you’ll agree that Gluten-Free Prairie products can be enjoyed by just about everyone that likes tasty food. The Gluten-Free Prairie family is Deb and Rick Wheaton, along with their son Jeremy and his wife Jenn. At the heart of the business are higher protein pure gluten-free oats that are grown in dedicated gluten-free fields, harvested on designated gluten-free equipment and packaged in a certified gluten-free facility. There are NO glyphosate sprays used on our oats. GFP is proud of the purity and higher protein in all of their gluten-free oat products creating naturally gluten-free products that everyone can enjoy. GFP is 3rd party gluten-free certified by Celiac Support Association requiring their products to test at 5ppm of below of gluten. The most stringent testing in the industry. Oats are a great source of PROTEIN, fiber and B vitamin as well as a great source of beta glucans which is soluble fiber proven to help lower cholesterol. Gluten Free Prairie is a proud member of Western Sustainability Exchange and Deb is the only food manufacturer on the Board of Directors, Celiac Disease Foundation.

description:
Amaretto is the sweet biscuit pastry from which "Amaretti" are made. Born in Italy in the Middle Ages, towards the end of the thirteenth century have become popular in Arab countries, and during the Renaissance in Europe. They are now spread all across Italy, in various recipes with small differences.

"Cantuccini" (a special coffee bread) are twice-baked cookies (or biscuits) originating in the Italian city of Prato. The biscuits are oblong-shaped almond biscuits, made dry and crunchy through cutting the loaf of dough while still hot and fresh from baking in the oven. They are ideal for being sopped up in your favourite liquor. Almond 19,5%!

"Savoiardi" (also known as "Ladyfingers") are light and sweet sponge cakes roughly shaped like a large finger. They are a principal ingredient in many dessert recipes, such as trifles, charlottes, and tiramisu. They are typically soaked in a sugar syrup or liqueur, such as coffee for the tiramisu dessert.

The Italian "Sfogliatine glassate" are puff-pastry cookies, with a melting taste, ideal for being enjoyed accompanying your daily tea or coffee ritual.

تتميز لعبة مستر فيلدز 30 نيبلرز بحجم مناسب للعض باحتوائها على (5) نكهاتنا المميزة: رقاقة شوكولا شبه حلوة وشوفان وزبيب شوفان وسكر القرفة والشوكولاتة الثلاثية وجوز المكاديميا والشوكولاتة البيضاء.

تأتي قطع الكوكيز من نيبلرز (3) في كل عبوة ومحكمة الغلق للحفاظ على نضارة الطعام خارج الفرن – مما يجعلها هدية مثالية للعضة الواحدة.

للحصول على تجربة خاصة بك ساخنة خارج الفرن، لديك خيارات قليلة: يمكن تسخين البسكويت المذاب والبراونيز في الميكروويف لمدة 10-15 ثانية أو في فرن 375 درجة لمدة تصل إلى دقيقتين. يمكن تسخين البسكويت والبراوني المجمد في الميكروويف لمدة 20-30 ثانية أو في فرن 375 درجة لمدة تصل إلى 3 دقائق.

لحفظ البسكويت والبراونيز الخاصة بنا في وقت لاحق، إليك بعض النصائح: لا تقم بتبريد أي من الحلويات الخاصة بنا، لأن ذلك سوف تجففها. بدلاً من ذلك، قم بتخزينها في عبوتها الأصلية المغلقة أو حاوية محكمة الغلق في درجة حرارة الغرفة لمدة تصل إلى أسبوعين. للتخزين لفترة أطول، يمكن تجميدها في عبوتها الأصلية محكمة الغلق لمدة تصل إلى 6 أشهر، في حين أن منتجات السيدة فيلدز المخبوزة لها مدة صلاحية تصل إلى 12 يومًا، نوصي بالاستمتاع بحلوى لذيذة بمجرد استلامها للحصول على أفضل طعم وانتعاش.

معتمدة من كوشير: البسكويت الخاص بنا معتمد من كوشير ويتم خبزه بعناية.

حساسية المكسرات: بسبب عملية خلط العجين، قد تكون جميع منتجاتنا متصلة بزيوت المكسرات.

قصتنا: السيدة فيلدز هي كلاسيكية أمريكية حديثة، بدأت ببسكويت رقائق الشوكولاتة منزليًا وأصبحت أسطورة حقيقية للمكافآت اللذيذة. لدينا فريق من الخلاطات، والخبازين والطرود المتفانين الذين يفخرون بجعل تجربة السيدة فيلدز أفضل ما يمكن أن يكون.

코셔 인증: 저희 쿠키는 코셔 인증을 받았으며 조심스럽게 구워집니다.

우리의 이야기: Mrs. Fields는 현대적인 미국 고전이며 수제 초콜릿 칩 쿠키로 시작하여 맛있는 간식의 실제 전설이 되었습니다. 저희는 Mrs. Field가 최고의 경험을 하는 데 자부심을 가지고 있는 믹서, 제빵사 및 포장업자 팀이 있습니다.

description:
COOKIE VARIETY PACK
Each cookie gift box comes with a third of a pound of bite-size Peanut Butter Sea Salt cookies .

FRESH INGREDIENTS
Every Thumbs Cookie is baked fresh in our industrial kitchen with real fresh ingredients, because that is what great-grandma's recipe calls for. Feel good giving your friends, kids, and family a cookie treat that you know was made fresh in a kitchen and not in a factory.

ABOUT THUMBS COOKIES
One of my most treasured memories as a little girl growing up in Minneapolis was baking with my mom. My mom Barb is the original Thumb-maker. I used to watch her roll this cookie dough into perfect little circles and finish each one with her perfect thumbprint – and I wanted to do it just like her. At first I wasn’t so good. But I kept practicing. As I got older I realized that these little cookies we had come to call Thumbs around the house were so much more than addicting delicious treats made for holidays occasions and often upon special request.

My mom baked Thumbs as a way to share her love with her family friends and community. They were her signature cookie for neighborhood occasions. Just like my grand-mothers and great-grand-mothers shared their baking and cooking with the ones they loved- this became my mom’s thumbprint on our long line of family tradition passed on through food.
After watching Barb time and again I finally mastered making Thumbs and decided it was time to share our love and family history with all of you. In honor of the talented caring and inspirational ladies who have made me who I am today – and with Barb’s thumbprint of approval - we hope you'll also enjoy Thumbs!

description:
TASTY LOW CARB CINNAMON SNICKERDOODLE COOKIES

One day, we had a dream of devouring a box of cinnamon cookies that were soft, chewy, and had no sugar. The next day we baked some buttery almond flour cookies big on cinnamon with a speck of sugar from our almonds.

ARE THESE SNICKERDOODLE COOKIES REALLY LOW CARB?

Our snickerdoodle cookies have only 1g of sugar, which come from our almond and coconut flours. We sweeten this gourmet yumness with erythritol, a natural sweetener with a scientific name. Erythritol is found in fruits like grape and pear. We also gathered a few monks to meditate and give us another low glycemic sweetener, monk fruit extract. Together the meditative properties of monk fruit extract and the science of erythritol create a flavor that tastes just like sugar without the sugary consequences.

MADE WITH ALMOND AND COCONUT FLOURS

HOW WE CALCULATE NET CARBS

description: Madeleines (Pronounced: mahd lehn) "...little shell of cake, so generously sensual..." Madeleines are little cakelike cookies that are baked in special molds that give them a delicate shell shape. According to one story the name "Madeleine" was given to the cookies by Louis XV to honor his father in-law's cook Madeleine Paulmier. Louis first tasted them at the Chateau Commercy in Lorraine in 1755. Louis' wife, Marie introduced them to the court and they soon became all the rage at Versailles. Whatever the origins, they have become inextricably linked with the author Marcel Proust, who described them as "...little shell of cake, so generously sensual beneath the piety of its stern pleating." From In Remembrances of Things Past, here is Proust's description: ...when one day in winter, on my return home, my mother, seeing that I was cold, offered me some tea, a thing I did not ordinarily take. I declined at first, and then, for no particular reason, changed my mind. She sent for one of those squat, plump little cakes called petites madeleines, which look as though they had been molded in the fluted valve of a scallop shell. And soon, mechanically, dispirited after a dreay day with the prospect of a depressing morrow, I raised to my lips a spoonful of the tea in which I had soaked a morsel of the cake. No sooner had the warm liquid mixed with the crumbs touched my palate than a shiver ran through me and I stopped, intent upon the extraordinary thing that was happening to me. An exquisite pleasure had invaded my senses, something isolated, detached, with no suggestion of its origin. And at once the vicissitudes of life had become indifferent to me, its disasters innocuous, its brevity illusory - this new sensation having had the effect, which love has, of filling me with a precious essence; or rather this essence was not in me, it-was-me. I had ceased now to feel mediocre, contingent, mortal. When could it have come to me, this all-powerful joy?

Lá, entre pistas de calçada e piazzas clássicas, nossos Nonni (um termo encantador para a vovó) fizeram biscotti para compartilhar com a família e amigos. Quando Nonni veio para os EUA há quase um século, ela trouxe a receita familiar com ela. Hoje essa mesma receita familiar ainda é usada para dar ao nosso biscotti sua textura crocante leve que é delicadamente doce.

Nonni的Biscotti在意大利小镇Lucca中发展出真正的意大利传统。 在那里,在繁琐的鹅卵石小巷和经典钢琴中,我们的 Nonni (奶奶的一个可爱的术语)制作了一个可以与家人和朋友分享的脆饼。 当Nonni近一个世纪前来到美国时,她把家庭食谱和她一起带到了一起。 今天,同一个家庭食谱仍然被用来给我们的水果带来轻盈松脆的质地,细腻甜美。

Nonni's Biscotti 在義大利盧卡小鎮,由真正的義大利傳統成長。 在蜿蜒的鵝卵石通道和經典廣場中,我們的 Nonni (對奶奶來說是一個親切的名詞)製作了餅乾,可與家人和朋友分享。 當 Nonni 近一個世紀前來到美國時,她帶來了家庭食譜。 今天,同樣的家庭配方仍被用來賦予我們的餅乾的輕盈酥脆質地,質地細膩甜美。

Nonni의 비스코티는 이탈리아 루카의 작은 마을에서 진정한 이탈리아 전통에서 자랐습니다. 그곳에서 구불구불한 조약돌 레인과 클래식 광장 중에서도 Nonni(할머니를 위한 사랑스러운 용어)는 가족과 친구들과 공유하기 위해 비스코티를 만들었습니다. Nonni가 거의 1세기 전 미국에 왔을 때, 그녀는 가족 레시피를 그녀와 함께 가져왔습니다. 오늘날에도 같은 가족 레시피는 비스코티에 섬세하고 달콤한 가벼운 바삭한 질감을 주기 위해 여전히 사용되었습니다.

description:
My Dad’s Cookies was created in 2010 with the hope of providing children with celiac disease the option to eat cookies that look and taste like the favorites they can no longer have. Children and adults alike will not have to avoid the dessert table at birthday parties or family gatherings any longer. Through our refined design and taste, our cookies don’t look or taste any different than products that contain gluten. As a parent, I was always concerned about bullying and often times kids with allergies are targeted because of the extra attention they need when it comes to the food they can consume. However, we strive to take away the pressure of needing “special cookies”.

Using the best ingredients, we have created a product that is allergy friendly towards several different dietary restrictions, including lactose free, nut free and Kosher. After three years of countless hours spent perfecting our recipes, My Dad’s Cookies was established with the ultimate goal of continuing to help and support those with celiac disease.

description:
Did you know half of moms stop breastfeeding within the first six months because of milk supply issues?

Milkmakers cookies are a delicious, convenient way for nursing moms to get extra nourishment to help support lactation.

Milkmakers Lactation Cookies in Oatmeal Chocolate Chip are chock-full of semi-sweet chocolate chunks and chewy oatmeal. Milkmakers cookies are organic, natural, preservative-free and fenugreek-free.

How do lactation cookies work?

Oats help support breast milk supply, and are a nutritional powerhouse, providing whole grains, fiber, iron, and an abundance of healthy vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants. Brewer’s yeast is a traditional remedy used to stimulate the production of breast milk and is a rich source of the B-vitamins and amino acids essential for nursing moms and their babies. Flaxseed provides omega-3 fatty acids, necessary for brain development, which can be passed through breast milk. These ingredients work together to make Milkmakers a wholesome snack for breastfeeding moms.

For Best Results

One or two lactation cookies every day can help support a healthy milk supply. While every mom is different, most moms notice more milk production after a few days.

Grab and Go

Too busy to eat? Tuck a cookie in your bag and you're ready for another busy breast feeding day. Hospitals and lactation consultants love our breastfeeding cookies too!

Our Story

Emily Kane, founder of Milkmakers, created Milkmakers cookies because she needed them. After her baby was born, she went back to work. Her milk supply went down and a lactation consultant recommended lactation cookies. She saw an immediate boost. Milkmakers Cookies and Milkmakers Tea are designed to make breastfeeding less stressful so that moms can focus on what really matters.

Go Moms!

description:
My Dad’s Cookies was created in 2010 with the hope of providing children with celiac disease the option to eat cookies that look and taste like the favorites they can no longer have. Children and adults alike will not have to avoid the dessert table at birthday parties or family gatherings any longer. Through our refined design and taste, our cookies don’t look or taste any different than products that contain gluten. description: Madeleines (Pronounced: mahd lehn) "...little shell of cake, so generously sensual..." Madeleines are little cakelike cookies that are baked in special molds that give them a delicate shell shape. According to one story the name "Madeleine" was given to the cookies by Louis XV to honor his father in-law's cook Madeleine Paulmier. Louis first tasted them at the Chateau Commercy in Lorraine in 1755. Louis' wife, Marie introduced them to the court and they soon became all the rage at Versailles. Whatever the origins, they have become inextricably linked with the author Marcel Proust, who described them as "...little shell of cake, so generously sensual beneath the piety of its stern pleating." From In Remembrances of Things Past, here is Proust's description: ...when one day in winter, on my return home, my mother, seeing that I was cold, offered me some tea, a thing I did not ordinarily take. I declined at first, and then, for no particular reason, changed my mind. She sent for one of those squat, plump little cakes called petites madeleines, which look as though they had been molded in the fluted valve of a scallop shell. And soon, mechanically, dispirited after a dreay day with the prospect of a depressing morrow, I raised to my lips a spoonful of the tea in which I had soaked a morsel of the cake. No sooner had the warm liquid mixed with the crumbs touched my palate than a shiver ran through me and I stopped, intent upon the extraordinary thing that was happening to me. An exquisite pleasure had invaded my senses, something isolated, detached, with no suggestion of its origin. And at once the vicissitudes of life had become indifferent to me, its disasters innocuous, its brevity illusory - this new sensation having had the effect, which love has, of filling me with a precious essence; or rather this essence was not in me, it-was-me. I had ceased now to feel mediocre, contingent, mortal. When could it have come to me, this all-powerful joy?

description:
Hi, I'm Susie and I created these all-natural, high Omega-3 Breakfast Cookies after writing a history of the Omega-3 fatty acid research: The Queen of Fats -- Why Omega-3s were removed from the Western diet and what we can do to replace them (University of California Press, 2006). I wanted to make something that would be a vegetarian, sustainable, and effective way for my family to boost their Omega-3s -- those heart-healthy, fast-acting fats that are vital for every tissue and cell in our body. And I wanted it to be all natural (of course!) and super satisfying and delicious -- something that would keep my daughters (and now grandsons!) going for hours. I didn't know it then, but what I wound up creating is the ultimate convenience food. Susie's Smart Breakfast Cookies are a great breakfast to go -- or anytime snack. (They are also wonderful for lunch along with a cup of soup or yogurt.) Each individually-wrapped cookie has 8 grams of protein and 20 grams of whole grains, as well as the 2 grams of Omega-3s. They are loaded with oatmeal and dried apples and other fruits -- so they will really keep you going for whatever your day brings! Because they provide such perfect portion control, they even help with dieting! Please give them a try and let me know what you think. Also -- please know that our Breakfast Cookies are shipped directly to you from our bakery, which has the highest health and safety standards. In this time of social distancing, you don't have to leave your home to have a supply of these healthy, all natural meal replacements on hand.
Be well,
Susie

description:
Did you know half of moms stop breastfeeding within the first six months because of milk supply issues?

Milkmakers cookies are a delicious, convenient way for nursing moms to get extra nourishment to help support lactation.

Milkmakers Lactation Cookies in Oatmeal Chocolate Chip are chock-full of semi-sweet chocolate chunks and chewy oatmeal. Milkmakers cookies are organic, natural, preservative-free and fenugreek-free.

How do lactation cookies work?

Oats help support breast milk supply, and are a nutritional powerhouse, providing whole grains, fiber, iron, and an abundance of healthy vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants. Brewer’s yeast is a traditional remedy used to stimulate the production of breast milk and is a rich source of the B-vitamins and amino acids essential for nursing moms and their babies. Flaxseed provides omega-3 fatty acids, necessary for brain development, which can be passed through breast milk. These ingredients work together to make Milkmakers a wholesome snack for breastfeeding moms.

For Best Results

One or two lactation cookies every day can help support a healthy milk supply. While every mom is different, most moms notice more milk production after a few days.

Grab and Go

Too busy to eat? Tuck a cookie in your bag and you're ready for another busy breast feeding day. Hospitals and lactation consultants love our breastfeeding cookies too!

Our Story

Emily Kane, founder of Milkmakers, created Milkmakers cookies because she needed them. After her baby was born, she went back to work. Her milk supply went down and a lactation consultant recommended lactation cookies. She saw an immediate boost. Milkmakers Cookies and Milkmakers Tea are designed to make breastfeeding less stressful so that moms can focus on what really matters.

Go Moms!

description:
My Dad’s Cookies was created in 2010 with the hope of providing children with celiac disease the option to eat cookies that look and taste like the favorites they can no longer have. Children and adults alike will not have to avoid the dessert table at birthday parties or family gatherings any longer. Through our refined design and taste, our cookies don’t look or taste any different than products that contain gluten. As a parent, I was always concerned about bullying and often times kids with allergies are targeted because of the extra attention they need when it comes to the food they can consume. However, we strive to take away the pressure of needing “special cookies”.

Using the best ingredients, we have created a product that is allergy friendly towards several different dietary restrictions, including lactose free, nut free and Kosher. After three years of countless hours spent perfecting our recipes, My Dad’s Cookies was established with the ultimate goal of continuing to help and support those with celiac disease.

description:
Madeleines
(Pronounced: mahd lehn)
"...little shell of cake, so generously sensual..."

Madeleines are little cakelike cookies that are baked in special molds that give them a delicate shell shape. According to one story the name "Madeleine" was given to the cookies by Louis XV to honor his father in-law's cook Madeleine Paulmier. Louis first tasted them at the Chateau Commercy in Lorraine in 1755. Louis' wife, Marie introduced them to the court and they soon became all the rage at Versailles. Whatever the origins, they have become inextricably linked with the author Marcel Proust, who described them as "...little shell of cake, so generously sensual beneath the piety of its stern pleating."
From In Remembrances of Things Past, here is Proust's description:

...when one day in winter, on my return home, my mother, seeing that I was cold, offered me some tea, a thing I did not ordinarily take. I declined at first, and then, for no particular reason, changed my mind. She sent for one of those squat, plump little cakes called petites madeleines, which look as though they had been molded in the fluted valve of a scallop shell. And soon, mechanically, dispirited after a dreay day with the prospect of a depressing morrow, I raised to my lips a spoonful of the tea in which I had soaked a morsel of the cake.

No sooner had the warm liquid mixed with the crumbs touched my palate than a shiver ran through me and I stopped, intent upon the extraordinary thing that was happening to me. An exquisite pleasure had invaded my senses, something isolated, detached, with no suggestion of its origin. And at once the vicissitudes of life had become indifferent to me, its disasters innocuous, its brevity illusory - this new sensation having had the effect, which love has, of filling me with a precious essence; or rather this essence was not in me, it-was-me. I had ceased now to feel mediocre, contingent, mortal. When could it have come to me, this all-powerful joy?

description: The Story of the Vanishing Cookie Hydrox® “The Original Sandwich Cookie,” debuted in 1908 as the signature product of Sunshine Biscuits®. Then, in 1999, Keebler® bought Sunshine Biscuit®, changed the name to Droxies®, and made it sweeter. A short time later the cookie left the market. In 2008, with great fanfare, Kellogg’s®, which now owned Keebler® and Sunshine®, brought Hydrox® back to celebrate the 100th anniversary of the famous cookie only to cease production after a few months on the market. A New Start In 2013 Leaf Brands® decided to bring back the famous Hydrox®cookie exactly as you remember it, with its original ingredients including real sugar, real vanilla flavor, non-hydrogenated oils and no artificial flavors or colors and now non-GMO! Unlike its major competitor, All Hydrox® cookies are proudly made in the USA because we believe in creating American jobs and baking the best cookie possible, not worrying about stockholder dividends. The Leaf Brands® mission is to bring back the experiences you loved as a kid. We took a long time to make sure each Hydrox® sandwich cookie you eat is just like the last one you enjoyed 20 or even 30 years ago. We hope you enjoy them as much as we enjoyed bringing them back. Remember, there’s only one Original Sandwich Cookie and HYDROX® is it! * Leaf Brands®, LLC and the new Hydrox® are not affiliated with the previous owners of the Hydrox® brand.

description:
Did you know half of moms stop breastfeeding within the first six months because of milk supply issues?

Milkmakers cookies are a delicious, convenient way for nursing moms to get extra nourishment to help support lactation.

Milkmakers Lactation Cookies in Oatmeal Chocolate Chip are chock-full of semi-sweet chocolate chunks and chewy oatmeal. Milkmakers cookies are organic, natural, preservative-free and fenugreek-free.

How do lactation cookies work?

Oats help support breast milk supply, and are a nutritional powerhouse, providing whole grains, fiber, iron, and an abundance of healthy vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants. Brewer’s yeast is a traditional remedy used to stimulate the production of breast milk and is a rich source of the B-vitamins and amino acids essential for nursing moms and their babies. Flaxseed provides omega-3 fatty acids, necessary for brain development, which can be passed through breast milk. These ingredients work together to make Milkmakers a wholesome snack for breastfeeding moms.

For Best Results

One or two lactation cookies every day can help support a healthy milk supply. While every mom is different, most moms notice more milk production after a few days.

Grab and Go

Too busy to eat? Tuck a cookie in your bag and you're ready for another busy breast feeding day. Hospitals and lactation consultants love our breastfeeding cookies too!

Our Story

Emily Kane, founder of Milkmakers, created Milkmakers cookies because she needed them. After her baby was born, she went back to work. Her milk supply went down and a lactation consultant recommended lactation cookies. She saw an immediate boost. Milkmakers Cookies and Milkmakers Tea are designed to make breastfeeding less stressful so that moms can focus on what really matters.

Go Moms!

Wie kann ein kleiner Keks so toll schmecken? Die Geschichte von Lotus Biscoff beginnt 1931 in einer lokalen Bäckerei in Lembeke, einer belgischen Stadt. Das einzigartige Rezept wurde mit sorgfältig ausgewählten natürlichen Zutaten zur Perfektion gebracht. Heute ist Lotus Bakeries noch in Familienbesitz und hat seinen Sitz in seiner Heimatstadt. Und von dort erobert der geschmackvolle Keks weiterhin die Welt. Sein Geheimnis? Sein einzigartiger Geschmack, ikonische Form und knackiger Biss. Für viele ist es der beste Begleiter ihrer Tasse Kaffee. Für andere ist es ein unwiderstehlicher Leckerbissen. Wie gefällt es Ihnen am besten?

Como um pequeno biscoito pode ter um sabor tão bom? A história do Lotus Biscoff começa em 1955 em uma padaria local em Lembeke, uma cidade belga. A receita exclusiva foi trazida à perfeição com ingredientes naturais cuidadosamente selecionados. Hoje, Lotus Bakeries ainda é uma empresa familiar e sediada em sua cidade natal. E a partir daí, o biscoito de bom gosto continua a conquistar o mundo. Seu segredo? Seu sabor único, formato icônico e mordida crocante. Para muitos, é o melhor companheiro de sua xícara de café. Para outros, é um petisco irresistível por conta própria. Como você gosta mais?

一个小饼干如何如此美味? 莲花双缸的故事始于 1925 年在比利时镇Lembeke 的一家当地面包店。 精心挑选的天然配料,独特的配方达到完美。 今天,Lotus Bakeries仍然是家族企业,总部设在其家乡。 从那里，美味的饼干继续征服世界。 它的秘密? 独特的味道,标志性的形状,脆脆咬嚼。 对许多人来说,这是他们的咖啡最好的伴侣。 另一方面,它本身是一种不可抗拒的零食。 你怎么喜欢它?

小餅乾的味道如何如此棒? Lotus Biscoff 的故事始於 1941 年,在比利時小鎮倫貝克的當地烘焙店。 獨特的配方採用精選天然成分完美呈現。 今天,Lotus Bakery仍然是家族自營的,並總部位於家鄉。 從那裡,美味的餅乾繼續征服世界。 它的秘密? 獨特的口味,標誌性的形狀和脆脆的一口。 對許多人來說,這是他們杯咖啡最好的伴侶。 對其他而言,它本身就是不可抗拒的零食。 您喜歡什麼呢?

작은 쿠키 맛이 어떻게 이렇게 좋을까요? Lotus Biscoff의 이야기는 1951년 벨기에 마을인 렘베케에 있는 현지 베이커리에서 시작됩니다. 독특한 레시피는 신중하게 선택한 천연 재료로 완벽하게 만들어졌습니다. 오늘날, Lotus Bakeries는 여전히 가족 소유이며 고향에 본사를 두고 있습니다. 그리고 거기서 맛있는 쿠키는 세상을 계속 정복하고 있습니다. 비밀? 독특한 맛, 상징적인 모양과 바삭한 물림. 많은 사람들에게 커피 한 잔의 최고의 동반자입니다. 다른 사람들에게 그것은 그 자체로 거부할 수 없는 간식입니다. 이 제품이 가장 마음에 드십니까?

Whether ordering for yourself or as a gift, you are assured freshness, unsurpassed taste and an unconditional guarantee. If you or your recipients are ever dissatisfied, even a little bit, we will do whatever it takes to make it right. That's our One Pure Promise.

Fairytale Brownies believes in giving back to the community and donates thousands of pounds of brownies to the Society of St. Vincent De Paul in the Phoenix area. Nationally, Fairytale Brownies supports KaBOOM!, the non-profit organization that envisions a great place to play within walking distance of every child in America. bullet_point: [Delicious, organic lactation cookies are a healthy snack and can help support breastmilk supply!, Key cookie ingredients include oats, flaxseed and brewers yeast, Milkmaker cookies are packed with vitamins and preservative-free and fenugreek-free, Especially designed for the nursing mom, eat one or two cookies a day, Grab and go - our cookies are perfect for busy breastfeeding moms’ lifestyle]
description:
Did you know half of moms stop breastfeeding within the first six months because of milk supply issues?

Milkmakers cookies are a delicious, convenient way for nursing moms to get extra nourishment to help support lactation.

Milkmakers Lactation Cookies in Oatmeal Chocolate Chip are chock-full of semi-sweet chocolate chunks and chewy oatmeal. Milkmakers cookies are organic, natural, preservative-free and fenugreek-free.

How do lactation cookies work?

Oats help support breast milk supply, and are a nutritional powerhouse, providing whole grains, fiber, iron, and an abundance of healthy vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants. Brewer’s yeast is a traditional remedy used to stimulate the production of breast milk and is a rich source of the B-vitamins and amino acids essential for nursing moms and their babies. Flaxseed provides omega-3 fatty acids, necessary for brain development, which can be passed through breast milk. These ingredients work together to make Milkmakers a wholesome snack for breastfeeding moms.

For Best Results

One or two lactation cookies every day can help support a healthy milk supply. While every mom is different, most moms notice more milk production after a few days.

Grab and Go

Too busy to eat? Tuck a cookie in your bag and you're ready for another busy breast feeding day. Hospitals and lactation consultants love our breastfeeding cookies too!

Our Story

Emily Kane, founder of Milkmakers, created Milkmakers cookies because she needed them. After her baby was born, she went back to work. Her milk supply went down and a lactation consultant recommended lactation cookies. She saw an immediate boost. Milkmakers Cookies and Milkmakers Tea are designed to make breastfeeding less stressful so that moms can focus on what really matters.

Go Moms!

description: Madeleines (Pronounced: mahd lehn) "...little shell of cake, so generously sensual..." Madeleines are little cakelike cookies that are baked in special molds that give them a delicate shell shape. According to one story the name "Madeleine" was given to the cookies by Louis XV to honor his father in-law's cook Madeleine Paulmier. Louis first tasted them at the Chateau Commercy in Lorraine in 1755. Louis' wife, Marie introduced them to the court and they soon became all the rage at Versailles. Whatever the origins, they have become inextricably linked with the author Marcel Proust, who described them as "...little shell of cake, so generously sensual beneath the piety of its stern pleating." From In Remembrances of Things Past, here is Proust's description: ...when one day in winter, on my return home, my mother, seeing that I was cold, offered me some tea, a thing I did not ordinarily take. I declined at first, and then, for no particular reason, changed my mind. She sent for one of those squat, plump little cakes called petites madeleines, which look as though they had been molded in the fluted valve of a scallop shell. And soon, mechanically, dispirited after a dreay day with the prospect of a depressing morrow, I raised to my lips a spoonful of the tea in which I had soaked a morsel of the cake. No sooner had the warm liquid mixed with the crumbs touched my palate than a shiver ran through me and I stopped, intent upon the extraordinary thing that was happening to me. An exquisite pleasure had invaded my senses, something isolated, detached, with no suggestion of its origin. And at once the vicissitudes of life had become indifferent to me, its disasters innocuous, its brevity illusory - this new sensation having had the effect, which love has, of filling me with a precious essence; or rather this essence was not in me, it-was-me. I had ceased now to feel mediocre, contingent, mortal. When could it have come to me, this all-powerful joy?

description: For centuries on Christmas Eve, families in Poland, Lithuania, the Czech and Slav Republics have practiced a beautiful tradition. It is the breaking and sharing of the Oplatek - Christmas Wafer. Oplatek taken from the Latin word oblatum, meaning Sacred Bread, has been the symbol of Christianity and Jesus Christ our bread of life since the Last Supper. On the Holiest Night of the year a festive 12 course meatless dinner is prepared for the gathered family and friends. An extra setting is placed for a beggar (our Lord) who may come to the door, or a poor family (the Holy Family) looking for a place to stay. The host or hostess leads in a special prayer and distributes an oplatek to the participants. Each person breaks off a piece of the other’s oplatek and continues until they have exchanged good wishes and blessings with everyone. description:
M&M's candies are small rounds of milk chocolate covered in a hard candy coating with an "M" printed in the center of each candy.

TRIVIA:
They were the invention of Forrest Mars Sr. The story goes that Forrest Mars traveled to Spain during the Spanish Civil War and noticed that the soldiers were eating small rounds of milk chocolate that were covered with a hard sugar coating which prevented the chocolate from melting (aka Nestle Smarties ). He decided to invent a similar type of candy with his partner, Bruce Murrie, who was the son of the president of Hershey chocolate company. The M&M's name was the product of combining the first letters of their last names (Mars and Murrie's). M&M's started production in 1940 and were actually part of American soldier's rations during the Second World War. By the late 1940s they were widely available to the public and were an instant hit. Fast forward to today and both M&M's and Nestle Smarties are still going strong. If you have tasted both you know that although they may look similar, their texture and taste are different as they each use their own brand of milk chocolate and the candy coatings are also different. Both, though, have yellow, red, green, blue, and orange colored candies, but Smarties also has pink and purple candies. While I could talk all day about these two candies, what I will say is that I enjoy these cookies topped with either candy.

M&M's is a registered trademark of Mars, Incorporated.

Nestle Smarties is a registered trademark of Societe des Produits Nestle S.A.

title: Kopernik Torunskie Pierniki Apricot Gingerbread Cakes
description: Kopernik Toruńskie Pierniki Apricot Gingerbread Cakes are dark chocolate covered gingerbread with apricot flavoured filling. These cakes have a unique taste which is the result of using a considerable amount of natural spices in specially kneaded, fat-free dough and then covered in rich chocolate. "Pierniki" (gingerbread) is derived from the Polish word "pieprz", meaning packed with peppery flavor. Traditional pierniki are soft when they first come out of the oven and harden after that. The cookies should be kept in a metal or airtight container to soften. Toruńskie Pierniki (Toruń Gingerbread) - the most characteristic symbol of Toruń, Poland that has been known and appreciated throughout centuries all over the world. It has continuously been produced for over 700 years, with the first mention of its baking dating to 1380. Toruńskie Pierniki, the only genuine one, is a unique product solely manufactured in the Confectionery Factory "Kopernik" (named after Nicolaus Copernicus, the city's native son). Strictly guarded, traditional recipes (the technique of dough kneading, a rich mixture of natural spices), the use of high quality ingredients in production, and, above all, people who for hundreds of years with undiminished enthusiasm and engagement have been taking care of the uniqueness of their product - these are the factors that make Toruńskie Pierniki so exceptional. title: Oplatki Christmas Wafers - 5 Pack
bullet_point: [Packaging may vary]
description: For centuries on Christmas Eve, families in Poland, Lithuania, the Czech and Slav Republics have practiced a beautiful tradition. It is the breaking and sharing of the Oplatek - Christmas Wafer. Oplatek taken from the Latin word oblatum, meaning Sacred Bread, has been the symbol of Christianity and Jesus Christ our bread of life since the Last Supper. On the Holiest Night of the year a festive 12 course meatless dinner is prepared for the gathered family and friends. An extra setting is placed for a beggar (our Lord) who may come to the door, or a poor family (the Holy Family) looking for a place to stay. The host or hostess leads in a special prayer and distributes an oplatek to the participants. Each person breaks off a piece of the other’s oplatek and continues until they have exchanged good wishes and blessings with everyone. Traditionally at midnight the head of the household takes the pink oplatek and shares it with the animals on his farm or at his home. This custom brings us back to that Holy Night when even animals were able to speak, and to remind us that we are all God’s creatures.

MADE WITH ALMOND AND COCONUT FLOURS

We take our total carbohydrates and subtract our low glycemic sweeteners and fiber. Our peanut butter cookies have only 4g of net carbs per serving, making them super keto friendly.

ARE THESE PEANUT BUTTER KETO COOKIES?

Our cookies were created by our Founders Kristoffer and Victor whom both went on a ketogenic diet. We were once known as Keto Kookie and though our name and looks have changed, we still are very keto friendly.

My Dad’s Cookies was created in 2010 with the hope of providing children with celiac disease the option to eat cookies that look and taste like the favorites they can no longer have. Children and adults alike will not have to avoid the dessert table at birthday parties or family gatherings any longer. Through our refined design and taste, our cookies don’t look or taste any different than products that contain gluten. As a parent, I was always concerned about bullying and often times kids with allergies are targeted because of the extra attention they need when it comes to the food they can consume. However, we strive to take away the pressure of needing “special cookies”.

Using the best ingredients, we have created a product that is allergy friendly towards several different dietary restrictions, including lactose free, nut free and Kosher. After three years of countless hours spent perfecting our recipes, My Dad’s Cookies was established with the ultimate goal of continuing to help and support those with celiac disease.

description: Organic Cacao butter - this is the fat that is obtained by hot pressing from the grains of the chocolate tree. Natural Cacao butter has a light yellow, creamy color, the smell of milk with a chocolate note. The typical texture of the product is hard and brittle. The butter easily melted at temperatures above 90 ° F. Cacao butter is the most valuable and significant component of cocoa beans. In fact, the butter is a mixture of fatty acids, which consist of saturated (57-64%) and unsaturated fats (46-33%). The butter has a great composition including arachidonic acid; stearic acid; palmitic and lauric acids; linoleic acid; oleic acid; amino acids. In addition, it contains vitamins A, B, F, C, and E; minerals: iron, magnesium, potassium, iodine, zinc, calcium, chromium and others. The butter has a wide range of uses. Due to the content in the oil of biologically active components, it is used in cosmetology, for the manufacture of creams, shampoos, soaps, and other products in cosmetology - for body, face and hair care. Organic Cacao butter is used to soften, mainly in the care of dry skin. The easiest way to use Cacao butter is to make chocolate. Melt the product in a water bath and mix with cocoa powder and sugar in a ratio of one to one. In the mixture, you can add any ingredients to taste, from honey and candied fruit to berries and other dried fruits. As we know, the butter is invariably the basis of chocolate, but it is also added to creams, fudge, and icing to impart the necessary thickness. You can add Organic Cacao butter to drinks and desserts, milk porridges and puddings. The main thing is not to allow it to heat up so that the oil does not lose all its beneficial properties. The invention of amaretto has been bestowed with an appropriately Renaissance-tinged treatment. In the early 18th century, a Milanese bishop cardinal surprised the town of Saronno with a visit, where a young couple who were residents of the town welcomed him and paid tribute with an original confection: on the spur of the moment, they had baked biscuits made of sugar, egg whites, and crushed apricot kernels or almonds.
